get.summary: `GET /api/v1/assignments` — list assignments by chapter or owner.
get.description: Lists assignments. Exactly one of `chapter_id` or `owner_id` is required; `role` optionally narrows by a single role bit. `incl` embeds related rows; dotted values imply their parent segments. Examples: `/api/v1/assignments?chapter_id=c_1&role=1&incl=chapter.comic.workset.team`, `/api/v1/assignments?owner_id=u_1&incl=user`.

parameters.name: chapter_id
parameters.description:
Chapter mode: list assignments on this chapter. Mutually exclusive with
`owner_id`.

parameters.name: owner_id
parameters.description:
Owner-user mode: list assignments owned by this user. Mutually exclusive
with `chapter_id`.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description:
Single role-bit filter. Must be a singular valid role bit; composite
values are rejected.

parameters.name: incl
parameters.description:
Related rows to embed. Repeatable. Values: `user`, `chapter`,
`chapter.comic`, `chapter.comic.workset`, `chapter.comic.workset.team`,
`chapter.creator`, `chapter.comic.creator`. Dotted values imply their
parent segments.

403.description: No permission to list these assignments

422.description: Exactly one of chapter_id or owner_id is required

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` — authenticates a user by QQ id and password.
post.description:
Public route. On success, sets the `authorization-token` cookie and returns
the user id with a signed token.

Public route. Logs the client out by clearing the `authorization-token`
cookie. The client will no longer send the token on subsequent requests.

204.description: Logged out successfully, auth cookie cleared

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/register` — registers a user via invitation code.
post.description:
Public route. On success, sets the `authorization-token` cookie and returns
the new user id with a signed token.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/members` — list members by team or owner.
get.description: Lists members. Exactly one of `owner_id` or `team_id` is required. In `owner_id` mode, `role` and `fuzzy_nickname` must be omitted. In `team_id` mode, `fuzzy_nickname` and `role` are optional. `incl` embeds related rows. Examples: `/api/v1/members?team_id=t_1&fuzzy_nickname=al&role=1&incl=user`, `/api/v1/members?owner_id=u_1&incl=team`.

parameters.name: owner_id
parameters.description:
Owner-user mode: list teams/memberships owned by this user. Mutually
exclusive with `team_id`; when set, `role` and `fuzzy_nickname` must be
omitted.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description:
Team mode: list members of this team. Mutually exclusive with
`owner_id`.

parameters.name: fuzzy_nickname
parameters.description: Substring filter on member nickname (team mode only).

parameters.name: role
parameters.description:
Single role-bit filter (team mode only). Must be a singular valid role
bit; composite values are rejected.

parameters.name: incl
parameters.description: Related rows to embed. Repeatable. Values: `user`, `team`.

AnnouncementInclOpt.description:
Incl opts for announcement info queries.

Each opt embeds additional related data into the returned
`AnnouncementInfoVal`.

ArchiveComicVal.description: Value returned after an active comic has been archived atomically.

AssignmentInclOpt.description:
Incl opts for assignment info queries.

Each opt embeds additional related data into the returned
`AssignmentInfoVal`. Dotted opts implicitly pull in the segments before
the dot (e.g. `chapter.comic.workset.team` also embeds `chapter`,
`chapter.comic`, and `chapter.comic.workset`).

ChapterInclOpt.description:
Incl opts for chapter info queries.

Each opt embeds additional related data into the returned
`ChapterInfoVal`. Dotted opts implicitly pull in the segments before the
dot (e.g. `comic.workset.team` also embeds `comic` and `comic.workset`).

ChapterInfoVal.description:
Presentation-ready chapter information.

Mirrors [`ChapterInfo`] but converts timestamps to Unix milliseconds
and exposes the same grouped field layout as the API response.

Construct via [`From<ChapterInfo>`] — the conversion is infallible.

[`ChapterInfo`]: crate::model::chapter::ChapterInfo

ChapterTranslationExportVal.description: JSON-safe export object for one translated chapter.

ChapterTranslationImportData.description: Request body for importing chapter translations.

ChapterTranslationImportVal.description: Summary returned after importing chapter translations.

ComicInclOpt.description:
Incl opts for comic info queries.

Each opt embeds additional related data into the returned
[`ComicInfoVal`]. Dotted opts implicitly pull in the segments before the
dot (e.g. `workset.team` also embeds `workset`).

ComicInfoVal.description:
Presentation-ready comic information.

Mirrors [`ComicInfo`] but converts timestamps to Unix milliseconds and
resolves the cover key to a signed download URL via [`ImagePool`] when
the cover has been uploaded.

Construct via [`ComicInfoVal::from_model`] — the conversion requires
an [`ImagePool`] instance for URL signing.

[`ComicInfo`]: crate::model::comic::ComicInfo

cover_url.description:
Resolved signed download URL for the cover image, or [`None`] if
no cover has been uploaded.

ComicWithOpt.description:
Extra data options for comic info queries.

Unlike `ComicInclOpt`, `with` opts attach derived rather than
directly related data (e.g. the chapter currently pinned to the comic).

CommentInclOpt.description:
Incl opts for comment info queries.

Each opt embeds additional related data into the returned
`CommentInfoVal`.

CreateAnnouncementData.description: Input parameters for creating an announcement.

CreateAnnouncementVal.description: Return value from creating an announcement.

CreateAssignmentInvitationData.description: Input parameters for creating an assignment invitation.

CreateAssignmentInvitationVal.description: Return value from creating an assignment invitation.

CreateChapterData.description: Input parameters for creating a new chapter.

subtitle.description:
Optional display subtitle; defaults to a generated value
if omitted (see [`default_subtitle`]).

[`default_subtitle`]: crate::complex::chapter::default_subtitle

CreateChapterVal.description: Return value from a successful chapter creation.

CreateComicData.description:
Input parameters for creating a new comic inside a workset.

The first chapter is created atomically with the comic. Its subtitle
can be customised via `first_chapter_subtitle`; when absent, a
locale-aware default (e.g. "Ch. 1") is generated.

first_chapter_subtitle.description: Optional subtitle for the first chapter created alongside the comic.

CreateComicVal.description:
Return value from a successful comic creation.

Includes the IDs of both the new comic and its auto-created first chapter.

CreateCommentData.description: Input parameters for creating a comment.

CreateCommentVal.description: Return value from creating a comment.

CreateMemberData.description: Input parameters for creating a member.

CreateMemberInvitationData.description:
Input parameters for creating a new team invitation.

The invitation binds a specific QQ ID (`invitee_qid`) to a [`RoleMask`]
that will be granted upon acceptance. The actual in-app user lookup
happens during the registration flow.

invitee_qid.description: The QQ ID of the person being invited (not a user UUID).

roles.description:
The role mask that will be assigned when the invitee registers
and accepts the invitation.

CreateMemberInvitationVal.description:
Return value from a successful invitation creation.

The `code` is a short opaque token the invitee presents during
registration to claim the invitation.

CreateMemberVal.description: Return value from creating a member.

CreateTeamData.description: Input parameters for creating a new team.

CreateWorksetData.description: Input parameters for creating a new workset inside a team.

CreateWorksetVal.description: Return value from a successful workset creation.

RoleField.description:
A singular role permission flag represented as a bit position.

Each role is a single bit value:

| Value | Name          | Description             |
|-------|---------------|-------------------------|
| 1     | `RAW_PROVIDER` | Raw provider            |
| 2     | `TRANSLATOR`   | Translator              |
| 4     | `PROOFREADER`  | Proofreader             |
| 8     | `TYPESETTER`   | Typesetter              |
| 16    | `REDRAWER`     | Redrawer                |
| 32    | `REVIEWER`     | Reviewer                |
| 64    | `PUBLISHER`    | Publisher               |
| 128   | `ADMIN`        | Admin                   |
| 256   | `BOT`          | Bot                     |

Only a **single** valid bit is accepted; composite values are rejected.

RoleMask.description:
A composite bitmask combining multiple role permission flags.

Bits are OR-ed together from the following role values:

| Value | Name          | Description             |
|-------|---------------|-------------------------|
| 1     | `RAW_PROVIDER` | Raw provider            |
| 2     | `TRANSLATOR`   | Translator              |
| 4     | `PROOFREADER`  | Proofreader             |
| 8     | `TYPESETTER`   | Typesetter              |
| 16    | `REDRAWER`     | Redrawer                |
| 32    | `REVIEWER`     | Reviewer                |
| 64    | `PUBLISHER`    | Publisher               |
| 128   | `ADMIN`        | Admin                   |
| 256   | `BOT`          | Bot                     |

**Examples:** `1` = RAW_PROVIDER, `6` = TRANSLATOR | PROOFREADER, `255` = all roles except BOT.

StageMask.description:
A composite bitmask storing the phase of all 6 workflow stages.

Each stage occupies 2 bits (4 possible states matching
[`StagePhaseField`]), ordered from low bits:

| Stage | Bits | Field |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| RawProvide | 0–1 | `StagePhaseField` |
| Translate | 2–3 | `StagePhaseField` |
| Proofread | 4–5 | `StagePhaseField` |
| TypesetRedraw | 6–7 | `StagePhaseField` |
| Review | 8–9 | `StagePhaseField` |
| Publish | 10–11 | `StagePhaseField` |
